description: For a nonempty classroom list and a phantom user whose RequestUser call succeeds, the rejection returns UNAUTHORIZED with debugMessage: null. errorToDebugMessage accepts nil safely, so this is a missing debug reason, not a crash or an authorization bypass.

finding.failure_scenario: For a nonempty classroom list and a phantom user whose RequestUser call succeeds, the rejection returns UNAUTHORIZED with debugMessage: null. errorToDebugMessage accepts nil safely, so this is a missing debug reason, not a crash or an authorization bypass.
finding.model_authored_prose: `errorToDebugMessage(err)` on line 180 is always passed a nil `err`. Control flow reaches line 175 only when `ktx.RequestUser()` on line 166 returned a nil error (the non-nil case returns at line 169), and `errorToDebugMessage` (line 157) short-circuits with `if err == nil { return nil }`. So every phantom/not-logged-in rejection returns `UNAUTHORIZED` with `debugMessage: null`, discarding the reason — while the `errors.Unauthorized()` constructed on line 176 for the log line is thrown away instead of being reused for the client-facing debug message. Introduced by this change; the four new tests all authenticate, so none covers this branch.
finding.summary: `errorToDebugMessage(err)` is passed a guaranteed-nil `err` in the phantom-user branch.
